Title: Ambrette Noir
Description:
A skin scent, but a deep one. Musky ambrette seed sits close to the body, softened by powdery iris and finished with a slow, smoky oud that lasts well into the evening.

Wear it when you want people to lean in.

Title: Rose Velours
Description: Rose without the old-fashioned powder. Turkish rose is warmed with a thread of saffron and wrapped in soft white musk, so it smells like velvet rather than a bouquet.

Title: Cèdre Blanc
Description: Pale wood and clean linen. Atlas cedar and dry vetiver open with a green snap of fig leaf, then settle into creamy sandalwood. Easy to wear every day, never boring.

Title: Ambre Nu
Description: Amber stripped back to its warm core. Resinous labdanum and benzoin, rounded with real Madagascan vanilla. Warm skin on a cold evening.

Title: Iris Poudré
Description: Iris is the most expensive note we use: the roots dry for three years before they are distilled. Here it is soft and buttery, with violet leaf and a whisper of suede.

Title: Sel Marin
